description: CsNaMo₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Cs is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing CsO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 97°. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.12 Å. Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.41 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.34 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.36 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Cs and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Mo atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Mo atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Cs and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Cs and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Mo atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaMo₃ tetrahedra.
